verdict.rationale: Apple's own tech-spec page documents on-chip hardware acceleration for H.264, HEVC, ProRes and ProRes RAW, which covers the HEVC and ProRes-class core of the story. AV1 is not mentioned anywhere in the pack, and the single spec line does not separate encode from decode. missing for 10: AV1 hardware decode/encode evidence, explicit encode-versus-decode breakdown, media-engine count or throughput details, independent or hands-on corroboration of editing and streaming workloads.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines carry my editing and streaming — documented hardware encode and decode (AV1, HEVC, ProRes-class) on the chip itself

citations.quote: Hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW
